reviews.text: Horrible company
My dog loves the place as he spent fantastic time playing with his fur pals. Staffs are ultra attentive and always give detailed report card.

Got my dog’s nails trimmed here, and they did a fantastic job! My dog was a bit stubborn at first, but they handled him so well and got the job done. I’ll definitely be coming back. The customer service was 10/10 from start to finish. Thanks again, guys!

Grooming services are very disappointing
Please don't go there. We have had multiple issues with our dog being nicked every time even after communicating every time to be careful. Not sure if they are professional groomers.
The staff were very friendly and helpful. Tiffany took great care of my Australian Labradoodle puppy for his first groom. She was very attentive to my requests and is really talented!

Day care is good, but the grooming services are very disappointing.

During a full grooming appointment, my dog was shaved without my consent. On a second visit, which was only for a bath, the staff refused to fully dry him, saying that he did not like it. My dog is extremely calm and has never had issues with grooming before, and I have never encountered this problem at any other grooming facility.

Unfortunately, while the day care experience has been positive, PARK 9's grooming services have been poor and unprofessional. If you are looking for grooming services, I would recommend considering PetSpa instead, as I have had a much better experience there.

Receptionist is lovely But it was expensive for a simple nail trimming, especially when the technician ended up cutting my dogs nail too short and having him bleed, starting 'I couldn't see the quick because of the dark nail colour'

We have been using Park 9 for 8 years and our doggie loves this place. We have done daycare at the downtown location, boarding at the Pearson location and grooming at both. Lovely, caring staff and a great experience all around.

By far the worst grooming experience ever. I’m not sure if they were having a busy day but we paid for the full groom and our dog came back still matted, paw pads weren’t trimmed properly, legs were shaved unevenly. You can do a better job yourself. It was a very choppy job with no attention to detail whatsoever. I am still brushing him as we speak 20 minutes later… After paying $130 here I feel completely disappointed. Not sure why this place has such stellar reviews. Perhaps we had a new groomer on an off day but I will not be returning.

Excellent Grooming and Playcare Experience.  We dropped our pup off for the day and returned to a beautifully groomed, clean and happy pup.  We appreciated that our dog was able to experience a fun day but also come back groomed.  We were able to have our own fun biking along the waterfront.  We definitely will be back every few months for this service.  We do not live downtown, but there is so much to do in Toronto, we can’t wait until we need another grooming so we can plan another adventure!

I had a deeply upsetting experience with Park9’s playcare service.

I dropped my dog off on a Saturday, trusting she would have a safe space to play and socialize. A couple of hours later, when I randomly checked the live footage online, I was horrified to see her tangled with another dog, struggling, while other dogs were acting aggressively. There was only one staff member supervising 15+ dogs, wearing headphones and focused on his phone, completely unaware of the chaos. Watching her struggle while no one intervened was heartbreaking.

I immediately called the front desk. They also saw the neglect on the webcam and notified the staff member. I explicitly requested that my dog be separated and said I would arrive in 10 minutes to pick her up early. Yet, when I checked the feed again just five minutes later, the same staff member was still distracted, my dog was not separated and aggressive behavior continued. My clear instructions were ignored.

When I arrived, my usually confident and happy dog was visibly stressed, frazzled, and slightly limping. It broke my heart. I requested the camera footage to understand what had happened and whether she needed a vet, but the manager refused. This lack of transparency and empathy only heightened my concern.

I trusted Park9 to provide safe, attentive care after doing my due diligence and asking relevant questions before enrolling her. Instead, I witnessed neglect, unsafe conditions, and a staff member clearly overwhelmed and inattentive. Please be cautious if you plan to leave your little ones here, monitor the cameras if you can, or consider other options. Aggressive dogs are allowed in playcare, which could be dangerous or influence your dog’s behavior.

My experience shows that the well-being of dogs may not be their priority, and the refusal to share footage confirms they are hiding something.

I’m so disappointed today. He got shaved down unevenly unnoticed when I told the groomer to leave the hair long on his head. I’ve been a customer here for 7 years every time the groomer shave him so I’ve learned to just bring him in for showers instead and once again I’ve learned my lesson to not bring him here for grooming anymore.

We love this place, and most importantly, so does our Frenchie, Olive! If you utter the words "Park 9" she gets so excited and immediately waits by the front door until we head over. It's conveniently located downtown which makes it great to send her to playcare weekly. The webcams on their website are great for new pet owners who can peak on their babies to see them having a blast. Their prices are reasonable, too!
Last year we tried their boarding and we thought it was good too! We got a bunch of photos while we were away, and getting the option to pick her up at the boarding facility the night of our arrival near Pearson was great.
Had a good experience with grooming! My Portie wasn't stressed at all and they were fast !
Love this place. The staff is friendly and accommodating and my dog loves the staff there too.  He always comes home pretty tired and happy after play time.  Thank you for welcoming me and my Pup!

Oscar was happy but the level of cleaning wasn’t that great, loose furs still around and he didn’t smell that great
Price was reasonable
My puppy loves it here. They are so kind and accommodating to both of us.

They take way longer than the 2 hours they say it will take to do the grooming. One time it took 5.5hours and the next time it took 3 hours.

The groomer they had before was amazing. But she is no longer there. The new groomer doesn't even cut around the butt area.

Following and calling them for updates when they are running late is very annoying. If you need more time just say it from the start instead of promising 1.5-2 hour service.

Needless to say, not going back.
I highly recommended Park 9 downtown.  It was my first time to bring my boy there for grooming.  My boy came home so happy.  Megan did an amazing job.  Thank you so much.
Staff were really nice!! Very clean and attentive.
Very friendly staff and great service :)
This place is great, small field with lots of friendly dogs close to my neighbourhood

THE BEST!!! we just moved to Toronto and we went from a house to a  tiny 1 br. I have a deaf, partially blind great pyr  mix (120 lbs) and a crazy heeler mix. I was nervous to put them in daycare or board them because transparency in dog care isn't always the best but oh my gosh I am so glad that I found Park9. Everyone at the dog park recommended them and now I know why. The staff is absolutely FABULOUS. They are clearly super well-educated on dog behavior and care and they are very proactive with questions and anticipating what my dogs need. I really liked the meet and greet process that eased us into the facility and it made me feel really comfortable that the other dogs were well-screened. My dogs are happy and exhausted when they come home and I can finally get some peace and quiet :) I wish every daycare were like this, truly the gold standard. Thank you to the awesome employees at Park9.

I highly recommend their grooming services! I’ve been taking my little guy here for 2 years. They never disappoint. Darrelle is outstanding. I request her every single time because she treats my dog so well and does a fantastic job.
Great cuts, daycare and staff.

Have been taking my puppy in for daycare. Love that the dogs are always monitored very closely and that you can watch them on the cameras at home. I also love how tired my dog is after the hours of play. Will definitely Continue to use Park 9.
Great Service!
Darrelle has been looking after our pups since day 1. She is simply the best. The staff is also awesome. Super accommodating with everything.  Bravo Park9!
